author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에는 2016년 11월 흑산도에서 가락지 조사를 하던 중 어린 암컷 1마리가 처음 확인된 길잃은새이다. 유럽과 북아프리카 서북부, 서아시아에서 시베리아에 걸쳐 번식하고 북쪽 무리는 겨울에 남쪽으로 옮겨 가며, 동아시아에서는 일본 리시리섬에도 1990년 4월 기록이 있다. 번식기에는 곤충과 그 애벌레를 주로 잡아먹고, 번식기가 아닐 때는 무리를 지어 땅 위에서 풀씨와 낟알을 먹는다.

points.en: white shoulder patch and white wing bar

sexes.male: 이마가 검고 정수리에서 뒷목까지 청회색이며, 얼굴과 멱, 가슴은 붉은 갈색, 등은 밤색이다.
sexes.female: 윗면이 칙칙한 회갈색이고 아랫면은 연한 회갈색이며, 날개의 흰 띠와 녹색 허리는 수컷과 같다.

young: 어린새는 어른새 암컷과 비슷하나 더 칙칙하고, 뒷목에 희끄무레한 점이 있으며 등은 녹색 기가 없는 갈색이다.

similar.how: 되새는 허리가 희고 어깨와 가슴이 주황색이지만, 푸른머리되새는 허리가 녹색이고 날개에 흰 띠가 두 줄 뚜렷하며 바깥꼬리깃이 희다.

art.subject: Eurasian Chaffinch (Fringilla coelebs), adult male in winter, a vagrant in Korean woodland edge usually among Bramblings: a narrow black band on the forehead; crown and nape blue-grey, partly veiled by brownish fringes; face, throat and breast rusty pink, fading to whitish on the lower belly; mantle chestnut-brown; rump olive-green; wings black with a large white shoulder patch, a white bar across the greater coverts and yellowish edges to the flight feathers; tail blackish with white outer feathers. Bill pale greyish-horn in winter; eye dark; legs pinkish-brown.
art.pose: foraging on the ground among fallen seeds, side view
art.scene: woodland edge with leaf litter and bare deciduous trees in Korea in winter (January), pale winter light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view foraging on the ground: blue-grey crown and nape, rusty-pink face, throat and breast paling on the belly, warm chestnut-brown mantle, olive-green rump, black wings with a white shoulder patch and white wing bar, black tail with white outer feathers, strong pointed bill
adult female, side view on the ground: mainly grey-brown head and body, paler below, the same white shoulder patch and white wing bar on dark wings, white outer tail feathers

adult male in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, white shoulder patches and white wing bars on black wings, chestnut-brown mantle, olive-green rump, black tail with white outer feathers
art.build: A sparrow-sized finch, slightly slimmer and longer-tailed than a sparrow, with a rounded head and short neck; walks and shuffles on the ground picking up seeds. Bill conical and sharply pointed, shorter than the head, not thick. Legs short, pinkish-brown. Tail fairly long and slightly notched. In flight it shows the bold white shoulder patch, the white wing bar, white outer tail feathers and a greenish rump.
avoid: Do not paint a white rump or orange shoulders and breast — that is Brambling; the Chaffinch's rump is olive-green.
Do not paint a black head or black mantle (male Brambling in spring).
Do not omit the double white wing marks: the large white shoulder patch and the white greater-covert bar.
Do not paint a thick grosbeak bill.
